0.1.0.lead: nextasks is rebuilt: tasks for families and small groups, in the browser and as an iPhone app.

sections.title: Collections, spaces and lists
sections.body: At the top the collections Today, Scheduled, All, Marked, Assigned to me and Completed, below them your spaces with their lists. Drag lists and spaces to sort them; a task dropped on a list moves there.

sections.title: Quick entry
sections.where: Below every list, or press N
sections.body: “Milk tomorrow 9am #groceries !!” creates a task with date, time, tag and priority. You see what was recognised while typing.

sections.title: Together with others
sections.body: Invite family or friends to a space with a link and assign tasks to one or more people. One is enough: whoever completes it first completes it for everyone.

sections.title: iPhone app and notifications
sections.body: Connect the iPhone app with a QR code. In the browser, notifications arrive as web push, also while the page is closed.

small: Columns per section, subtasks, attachments, repetitions in words instead of formulas.
Trash for 30 days, search, keyboard shortcuts, light and dark.
